recipes.name: Spiced Black Bean & Rice Salad in a Jar
instructions: Cook the rice according to the package instructions. Once cooked, let cool completely.
Add all of the spiced bean ingredients to a large pan over medium-high heat.
Cook for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from the heat and let cool completely.
Make the dressing by mixing all ingredients in a bowl.
To assemble the mason jar, start by dividing the dressing between the jars. Then add the rice at the base, followed by the beans and veggies.
When ready to devour, give it a good mix. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use pure ground chili powder made from dried chili peppers - not to be confused with the chili powder spice blend commonly found in the US, which often includes cumin, garlic powder, and other seasonings. For the intended heat and flavour, be sure to use pure chili powder. † To keep the chopped avocadoes from browning, toss them in a bit of lemon or lime juice, if desired.
Storage The meal can be stored in mason jar in the fridge for up to 4 days.
